newsitem.title: USA: National Service to buy back more shares.
newsitem.headline: National Service to buy back more shares.

text.p: National Service Industries Inc said Monday its board of directors had authorized the repurchase of an additional 1.25 million shares.
The company said the repurchase comes in addition to an earlier program to buy back up to two million shares a year.
As of March 19, it had about 45.0 million average shares outstanding.

National Service, which runs four businesses including lighting equipment, textile rental, specialty chemical and envelopes, also announced the sale of plants and related assets to G&K Services Inc for $287 million.
The company said the 29 plants and other assets represented about 40 percent of its textile rental volume.
